meta.title: Configurable Intake Templates: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Sign in as a Tenant Admin on a tenant below Growth and inspect whether Configurable Intake Templates is absent or refused.
Retrieve template types for PRs, standalone approvals, and PO-amendment requests through Configurable Intake Templates.
Repeat the same workflow on a Growth tenant and verify that it is available.
Compare capability availability across tenants with different subscription plans; switch_company only supports named company IDs, not plan-tier selection or verification.
